search_scope: Selected settings, commands, persistence, install, mods, shortcut and Android adapter implementations, not every branch/provider/dependency.

No native build/runtime, protected device, backend/service validation or binary-semantic completeness is implied.
unknowns: Main UI binary member representation remained unavailable at the analysis tool representation budget; complete binary recovery is not claimed.
Source-to-shipped-binary semantic equivalence, backend operations/moderation/signing policy and full provider behavior are unestablished.
Lawful catalog/review/art/mod sourcing, historical payload availability and adapter-specific prerequisites require independent proof.
All target package/runtime/hardware/input/accessibility/performance gates remain untested by this contract.
Android ABI/minimum SDK and macOS package/container compatibility require explicit build/runtime decisions; Android APK does not mean desktop execution.
MSI/Flatpak/APK rollback differs from portable payload rollback; native OS installer consent and noninterruptible phases require adapters.
